Specification: The standard TLA+ Proof System (TLAPS) module. It defines operators for various backend provers (SMT, Zenon, Isabelle) and provides a library of fundamental TLA+ temporal and inductive rules as theorems.
TheoremNames: SetExtensionality == \A S,T : (\A x : x \in S <=> x \in T) => S = T
RuleTLA1 == ASSUME STATE P, STATE f, P /\ (f' = f) => P' PROVE  []P <=> P /\ [][P => P']_f
RuleTLA2 == ASSUME STATE P, STATE Q, STATE f, STATE g, ACTION A, ACTION B, P /\ [A]_f => Q /\ [B]_g PROVE  []P /\ [][A]_f => []Q /\ [][B]_g
RuleINV1 == ASSUME STATE I, STATE F, ACTION N, I /\ [N]_F => I' PROVE  I /\ [][N]_F => []I
RuleINV2 == ASSUME STATE I, STATE f, ACTION N PROVE  []I => ([][N]_f <=> [][N /\ I /\ I']_f)
RuleWF1 == ASSUME STATE P, STATE Q, STATE f, ACTION N, ACTION A, P /\ [N]_f => (P' \/ Q'), P /\ <<N /\ A>>_f => Q', P => ENABLED <<A>>_f PROVE  [][N]_f /\ WF_f(A) => (P ~> Q)

RuleSF1 == ASSUME STATE P, STATE Q, STATE f, ACTION N, ACTION A, TEMPORAL F, P /\ [N]_f => (P' \/ Q'), P /\ <<N /\ A>>_f => Q', []P /\ [][N]_f /\ []F => <> ENABLED <<A>>_f PROVE  [][N]_f /\ SF_f(A) /\ []F => (P ~> Q)

RuleWF2 == ASSUME STATE P, STATE f, STATE g, STATE EM, ACTION A, ACTION B, ACTION N, ACTION M, TEMPORAL F, <<N /\ B>>_f => <<M>>_g, P /\ P' /\ <<N /\ A>>_f /\ EM => B, P /\ EM => ENABLED A, [][N /\ ~B]_f /\ WF_f(A) /\ []F /\ <>[]EM => <>[]P PROVE  [][N]_f /\ WF_f(A) /\ []F => []<><<M>>_g \/ []<>(~EM)

RuleSF2 == ASSUME STATE P, STATE f, STATE g, STATE EM, ACTION A, ACTION B, ACTION N, ACTION M, TEMPORAL F, <<N /\ B>>_f => <<M>>_g, P /\ P' /\ <<N /\ A>>_f /\ EM => B, P /\ EM => ENABLED A, [][N /\ ~B]_f /\ SF_f(A) /\ []F /\ []<>EM => <>[]P PROVE  [][N]_f /\ SF_f(A) /\ []F => []<><<M>>_g \/ <>[](~EM)
RuleInvImplication == ASSUME STATE F, STATE G, F => G PROVE  []F => []G
RuleStepSimulation == ASSUME STATE I, STATE f, STATE g, ACTION M, ACTION N, I /\ I' /\ [M]_f => [N]_g PROVE  []I /\ [][M]_f => [][N]_g

DivisionNotes: All zero-arity prover-pragma operators (SMT, CVC3, Auto, etc.) are defined as 'Op == TRUE' so their bodies are Boolean state predicates -> placed in OperatorDefNames_StatePredicate.

All parameterized timeout/tactic operators (SMTT(X), IsaMT(X,Y), etc.) take parameters; their bodies are TRUE but they are operator-with-arguments value definitions -> placed in OperatorDefNames_ValueDef.
TemporalNesting is true: rules like RuleWF2 / RuleSF2 nest temporal operators heavily ([][...]_f /\ <>[]EM, []<><<M>>_g, etc.).
VerificationTools=[TLAPS] because this module is the TLAPS proof-system meta-module re-exporting backend pragmas.

PrimedVariables: only state symbols actually appearing primed in rule bodies (P', I', f') are listed; capitalised STATE/ACTION letters such as Q, F, EM appear in obligations but are not all primed in this file.
There are no state variables declared; the module contains only backend pragmas, theorems, and rule schemas.
ProofHints is the set of prover-pragma operator names invokable via BY/USE.
